import subprocess
repo="/Volumes/migodam's-external-brain/Research/Inv_SLAM/Gaussian/Research_W/publish-w-p0"
base=['git','-C',repo]
assert not subprocess.check_output(base+['diff','--cached','--name-only']).strip(), 'Unexpected preexisting staged work'
subprocess.run(base+['add','-f','research/research_w_slam','research/index.html','research/README.md'],check=True)
paths=subprocess.check_output(base+['diff','--cached','--name-only'],text=True).splitlines()
assert all(p.startswith('research/research_w_slam/') or p in ('research/index.html','research/README.md') for p in paths)
print('Staged own research files:',len(paths),flush=True)
subprocess.run(base+['commit','-m','Complete W-SLAM Maxwell compensation, finite belief and revisitation experiments'],check=True)
print(subprocess.check_output(base+['rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True))
